issues.what: The golden-ochre identity is diluted to cream / pale tan. It still reads golden in the portrait and splash. In game the jars read cream, and from behind on FRAY almost bone. In the three.js QA close-up the mask reads near-bone and the jars pale grey-cream. In the icon the pale mask has less contrast against the pale backdrop.
issues.evidence: Crops of value_fray_high_odrum_verify_f_odrum and value_rift_high_odrum_verify_f_odrum: jar and mask mean #BAA182 / #C5A47F (L* 67–69, saturation 0.29–0.34). three_odrum.png (bottom row, mask close-up) against pre_three_odrum from commit e81f6055. Icon before and after. This is on brief (the sandstone role is #D8C19D, L* 79, 27%) but a step away from the concept's golden ochre.
issues.fix: Optional design call: amend the brief or accept the trade-off. To win back some gold at the same saturation, drop the jar glaze about 4–5 L* (darker, golden-tan rather than cream) at hue 33–34. Do not raise saturation.

issues.what: Under the warm character light in game, the paler cap dome and the lifted shoulders and upper back read pinkish / salmon. This existed before; it is more visible now that they are lighter.
issues.evidence: In-game crops vfy_odrum_close.png and art2_odrum_close.png. The cap albedo is #AA8D76 (hue 26.5) and the coat mean #83614E (hue 21.5). COAT_FADED pulls the coat only partly toward tan.
issues.fix: Nudge the cap and COAT_FADED a few degrees toward hue 30–32, or raise COAT_FADE to about 0.6. The value should not change.

issues.what: The skins inherit COAT_LIFT. Shadeprint's upper body is now paler in the splash, which slightly deepens the open minor that it reads as a pale robe.
issues.evidence: Shadeprint splash chest crop: p50 L* 56 → 66, share above L* 86 9% → 17%. Shadeprint lineup 58.8 / 41.8 / 14.5 → 59.4 / 44.9 / 14.4.
issues.fix: Scale COAT_LIFT down or skip it for Shadeprint, whose pale top already comes from its own per-part lift.

issues.what: lineup_qa valueGradientOk is still False: at the game camera with no character light, top 63.2 is under 70 and feet 16.4 under 20. The gradient is monotone, and better than before (55.3 / 43.2 / 16.0). This was failing before the polish, so it is not a regression.
issues.evidence: art/renders/fighters/odrum/lineup_polish.json, odrum facing 0: valueGradientOk false, valueGradientMonotone true.
issues.fix: No action needed for this pass. The in-game probe, with the character light, is the gate that matters and it passes.

issues.what: Splash only: the mask's lit planes are very light, close to the Noonwhite range, though warm (saturation about 0.38), so they do not read as Noonwhite.
issues.evidence: splash.png mask crop (1095,185, 60×70): median L* 84.5, 35% of pixels above L* 86 (was median 76, 7%). This is with the splash sun already lowered to 2.25.
issues.fix: Optional: drop the hero sun another step, or lower the mask albedo 2–3 L*, for the splash only.
